sourcePolicy: Les neuf PNG canoniques et sept SVG ont ete lus/inspectes. Les neuf sorties finales sont des generations nouvelles via prompts. validationMethod: Inspection de chaque source et sortie par view_image. Verification PNG carre, canal alpha, pixels transparents, interieur quasi opaque, bbox alpha >=128 et marges. Vignettes 80x80 sur #f4f5f6 et #20252b composees en memoire uniquement. Un residue alpha <=1/255 au bord est signale sans le confondre avec un fond opaque.

assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE NEW race logo for the fantasy card game Kalistar, an actual graphic heraldic SIGN, NOT a portrait or character illustration. Square PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background, never a painted checkerboard or solid backdrop. One primary silhouette, at most THREE broad visual masses, bold clean readable edges at 80 x 80 pixels. Minimal shallow relief, matte patinated ivory and aged silver with one restrained race-specific enamel accent. Broad painted planes, slight material wear, no photorealistic texture, no glossy chrome, no heavy 3D bevels, no intricate engraving. Center the complete symbol, approximately 80 percent canvas height or width as appropriate, with about 10 percent transparent safe margins, no clipping. No outer circle, disc, ring, medallion, shield, housing, frame, pedestal, cast shadow, glow, aura, text, lettering, watermark or extra ornaments. Deliver a single finished isolated logo only, not a sheet or mockup. SUBJECT: a single complete natural adult HUMAN standing in relaxed contrapposto, slight three-quarter orientation, both arms hanging loosely beside the body, hands at thigh level, two separated legs and feet firmly on an invisible baseline. Exactly one head, two arms, two hands, two legs. Adult proportions about seven and a half heads tall, ordinary adult shoulders and believable elbows/knees; not a child, mannequin, robot or muscular superhero. Simplify to a clean sculpted heraldic silhouette with no facial features, simple short hair, plain unobtrusive tunic and trousers suggested by large planes, no armor, helmet, mask, weapons, props or cape. Warm ivory/silver figure with a single muted cobalt-blue tunic area; only broad large tonal planes, no seams or clothing detail. The recognizability must come from the natural whole human shape and relaxed pose, NOT a bust, head logo, frontal mask, stick-figure road sign, Vitruvian pose or spread arms. Figure height 80 percent canvas, horizontal centering; natural body width, do not widen the anatomy to fill square.

qa.framingNote: Silhouette naturelle etroite; hauteur 89.23% au lieu des 80% vises. Non tronquee, bras et jambes lisibles.
